title: 10 Colones

obverse.description: The arms of Costa Rica (seven stars representing the seven provinces, three extinct volcanoes for the three mountain ranges, two ships symbolizing the country's geographical situation between the Atlantic and Pacific ocean and sunrise on the left) along with the country name above and the date below
obverse.lettering:
REPUBLICA DE COSTA RICA
AMERICA CENTRAL
REPUBLICA DE COSTA RICA
1997
obverse.lettering_translation:
Republic of Costa Rica
Central America
Republic of Costa Rica

reverse.description: The value above coffee branches and initials of the "Banco Central de Costa Rica" and the value in Braille
reverse.unabridged_legend:
10
Colones
⠁⠚
Banco Central de Costa Rica
reverse.lettering_translation:
10
Colones
10
Central Bank of Costa Rica

comments:
The size and space between letters vary depending on the year along with the outer rim of Coat of Arms slightly different, and finally versions with smoking volcanoes and without smoke on the obverse.

 

Although these coins have been demonetized, they are still redeemable at the Central Bank of Costa Rica.
